item.title: [github_trending] tt-a1i/archify
item.description: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It turns a codebase or system description into an interactive system map directly in chat, compiling typed JSON IR into self-contained HTML/SVG. It ships with five diagram types, four presets, light/dark themes, and Before/Delta/After snapshots for reviewing architecture changes before merge.

item.title: [juejin] Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
item.description: After a year on Cursor, the author's company switched to OpenAI Codex in April 2026 because Cursor moved to usage-based pricing that became more expensive and unpredictable. Two weeks into the switch, he sees Codex as a genuine super-agent, not just a coding assistant, while Cursor's strengths remain in tight editor integration, Tab completion, and the freedom to choose mainstream models.

item.description: Tencent has open-sourced Hunyuan Hy4 preview with 770B total parameters, 49B active, and 1M+ context, tuned for agent, coding, and productivity tasks. It was involved in optimizing its own training and operators, forming a recursive self-improvement loop, and improving end-to-end throughput by 31.8%. API pricing is 6 CNY input and 18 CNY output per million tokens; WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy are free for two weeks.

item.title: [v2ex] [奇思妙想] 垂直领域 Coding 场景意图识别模型开放权重与 API 使用
item.description: To route intents for PI Agent, the author trained a 0.6B intent-classification model for coding scenarios, fine-tuned from jina-embeddings-v5 and supporting 12 ops/coding signals; after two weeks in an internal gateway it hits roughly 70-75% accuracy while cutting costs. Weights are on Hugging Face under CC BY-NC 4.0, with a woq8 quantized version and a free public API, and the API source is open-sourced so others can test and deploy it.

item.title: [infoq] 1周半写64个PR、完成30%项目重构：一家成熟SaaS公司把Agent塞进研发全流程后
item.description: Calendly, a scheduling SaaS company, detailed how it embeds AI agents across Jira, GitHub, CI and production workflows: agents review requirements, split tasks, write code in parallel, run tests and QA, with humans doing final review and merge. In its IAM team, agents generated 64 PRs in one and a half weeks and completed about 30% of a large decoupling project. The takeaway: the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to requirement alignment and judgment.

item.title: [infoq] 你的 Agent 已经上线生产环境，下一步怎么办？ | 技术实践
item.description: Snowflake is expanding Cortex Agents with new capabilities for enterprises running agents in production, targeting operational pain points in orchestration, execution, and governance. Highlights include the Async Agent API, interrupt/resume, partial access controls, and a versioning UI, along with previews like Build Coding Agent and Tool Search — aimed at moving agents from "buildable" to "operable at scale."

item.title: [infoq] 智谱认领“牛来”模型，实测：“牛马”友好
item.description: Zhipu confirmed that Ox Alpha, the anonymous model that climbed OpenRouter's trending list, is GLM-5.3-Flash. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 320B total parameters but only about 18B active per token; the anonymous test version offered 1.04M-token context and accepted text, image, and video input. Stripe CEO Patrick Collison said it was 'very impressive,' and Zhipu said all test traffic ran on clusters built with domestic AI chips.

item.title: [infoq] 谷歌落后一个时代？CEO 亲自官宣“语音转文字”模型，网友：你们看不清形势啊
item.description: Google unveiled Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, which CEO Pichai announced on X as its most accurate speech-to-text model. It cleans up fillers, mistakes, and repetitions, understands self-corrections like 'no, make it Wednesday,' supports 85+ languages with live switching, and can identify up to eight speakers. According to Artificial Analysis, word error rate is 4.0% for streaming and 2.6% for non-streaming transcription.

item.title: [infoq] 从方案走向运行｜世界人工智能开源大赛（GOAI）复赛作品提交正式开启
item.description: The World AI Open Source Competition (GOAI) has entered its rematch round: tracks 1–3 must submit by Sept 3 18:00, while track 4 debugging runs into mid-September. The Agent Infra track now demands an AgentTeams-based design with at least three distinct agents, along with validation, code, and a demo video. Online defenses are Sept 4–6.

item.title: [infoq] Cloudflare 发布 Kitesurf，一款面向 AI 智能智能体的浏览器引擎
item.description: Cloudflare released Kitesurf, a lightweight browser engine built for AI agents. It runs browser components in isolated WebAssembly/Rust environments on Cloudflare Workers, supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol, so Playwright and Puppeteer can drive it with lower overhead than full Chromium. Built on the Rust-based Blitz rendering engine and Firefox's Stylo CSS parser, it omits video, WebGL, and real-world TLS bot checks; some Hacker News commenters raised conflict-of-interest concerns because Cl

item.title: [infoq] 规模化 AI 代码审查：LinkedIn 的多智能体方案
item.description: LinkedIn built a multi-agent AI code review platform instead of bolting a generic tool onto GitHub. It combines independent reviewers using different models and reasoning methods, applies organization- and repo-specific rules, and filters noise. In an evaluation of 5,230 sampled comments across 1,727 PRs, 63.9% of suggestions were adopted; logic-error and concurrency fixes were accepted 80% and 100% of the time respectively.

item.title: [infoq] 下一层抽象：从UX角度思考Agentic OS的样貌
item.description: This InfoQ opinion piece looks at Agentic OS from a UX perspective. GUIs already hide complexity, but they still force users to translate intent into software operations: a user sees a blurry video while the app offers codec, bitrate, and resolution settings. The author argues that power users mistake hard-won computer experience for common sense, and agent interfaces may be the next abstraction layer for expressing goals directly.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 做了一个在线 Lip Sync 工具，想听听大家的体验反馈
item.description: A developer shared lipsync.vip on V2EX, an online AI lip-sync tool that turns a photo of a person or pet plus audio into a talking video. The pipeline is intentionally simple: upload, add audio, generate. The creator wants feedback on first-run confusion and known pain points like mismatched mouth movements, head motion, and deformation.

item.title: [v2ex] [Java] 开源:用刚发布的 Spring AI 2.0.1，撸了一个全功能 Agent
item.description: A V2EX user open-sourced hermes-agent-demo, a server-side agent built with the newly released Spring AI 2.0.1, JDK 25, and Spring Boot 4.1. It supports web search, page scraping, hot-swappable MCP, subagents, RAG, human-in-the-loop approval, and sandboxed code execution, with Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenAI, and custom model backends. All is open source except a packaged frontend; the author recommends it as a starting scaffold for AI projects.

The author found no solution in AI tools or forums, so this is a practical workaround for affected users.

Per-entry memory dropped by 56%, freeing roughly 100 TB of memory across the company's fleet. Worth reading if you work on DNS infrastructure or large-scale Rust performance tuning.

item.description: A programmer with seven years of coding experience applied CI/CD thinking to AI-assisted novel writing, building a tool called NovelOps and successfully running a 270-chapter serial. The article argues that around chapter 30 AI-generated stories reliably collapse for three structural reasons: context-window limits that drop earlier details and setups, uncontrolled cross-chapter pacing, and hardening narrative clichés. Worth reading for anyone using LLMs for long-form fiction.

item.title: [github_trending] JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines
item.description: JetBrains has released the official go-modern-guidelines repo to help AI coding agents write modern Go. The guidelines, covering features from Go 1.0 through 1.27, steer agents toward idioms like max(a,b), slices.Contains, and cmp.Or, plus Go 1.26 additions such as new(42) and errors.AsType[T](err). Agents first detect the Go version from go.mod and then use only features up to that version, addressing training-data lag that makes models emit outdated code. Relevant for teams using AI assistants
